title: Cruise Outbreaks Climbed To 20 Despite Newer Ships
hook: Newer cruise ships still logged 20 outbreaks.
closing: New ships cannot replace hygiene when thousands share tight spaces.
question: Would outbreaks change your cruise pick?

segments.say: Cruise outbreaks reached 20, so newer ships have not made group illness disappear.
Norovirus caused 15 cruise outbreaks, making one familiar stomach bug the main problem.
A cruise ship can carry 7,600 guests, giving infection thousands of close contacts.
